known.via: English Wikipedia "Ycoden-Daute-Isora" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation in western Tenerife, covering towns such as Icod de los Vinos, Garachico and Guía de Isora. It gained its DO in 1994, and its rules allow wine from grapes such as Listán Blanco, Gual, Malvasía and Listán Negro.
